subject: Food and Nutrition
provisional_note: Semester 1 (Jul-Dec 2026) follows the official MoEST 2026 calendar. Semester 2 (Jan-May 2027) is inferred from the 2026 pattern and ends before the ACSEE examinations - replace it with the published 2026/2027 almanac before relying on those dates.

entries.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of principles of Food and Nutrition
entries.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an understanding of the dietary needs for different groups of people
entries.learning_activity: (a) Explain the concept of groups with special dietary needs (meaning, category and reasons)
teaching_learning_activities: Brainstorming: Guide students to brainstorm on the meaning of groups with special dietary needs
Group discussion: Guide students to discuss categories of groups with special dietary needs
entries.assessment: The concept of groups with special dietary needs is well explained
resources: Charts depicting categories of groups with special dietary needs
entries.references: TIE, Food and Nutrition for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Five: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of principles of Food and Nutrition
entries.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an understanding of the dietary needs for different groups of people
entries.learning_activity: (b) Analyse the nutritional requirements for each special group (children, adolescents, elders, vegetarians, pregnant women and lactating mothers, invalids and convalescents)
teaching_learning_activities: Scenario: Provide a scenario for students to identify nutritional needs of groups with special dietary needs then guide them to share
Field trip: Organise a field trip to health centres for students to observe nutrition education provided and write the report
entries.assessment: Nutritional requirements for each group are well analysed
resources: Charts depicting nutritional requirements for different special groups of people.
entries.references: TIE, Food and Nutrition for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Five: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of principles of Food and Nutrition
entries.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an understanding of the dietary needs for different groups of people
entries.learning_activity: (c) Explain the concept of Nutrients values (meaning, types, uses and major factors considered in developing nutrient values)
teaching_learning_activities: Group discussion: Guide students to explore the concept of nutrient values
Group discussion: Guide student to explore meaning types uses and major factors considered in developing nutrient values
entries.assessment: The concept of Nutrients value is well explained
entries.references: TIE, Food and Nutrition for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Five: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of principles of Food and Nutrition
entries.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an understanding of the dietary needs for different groups of people
entries.learning_activity: (d) Use RDA/NRV’s tables to determine nutritional requirements of individuals
teaching_learning_activities: Group discussion: Guide students to use RDA/NRV’s tables to determine nutritional requirements of individuals
entries.assessment: Nutritional requirements of each group are determined
entries.references: TIE, Food and Nutrition for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Five: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of principles of Food and Nutrition
entries.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an understanding of the dietary needs for different groups of people
entries.learning_activity: (e) Compute the nutrients intake for different groups using food composition tables and compare with RDA
teaching_learning_activities: Group discussion: Guide students to use various food composition tables to compute nutrient intake for various individuals and make comparison with RDA
entries.assessment: Nutrients intake for different groups are well computed and compared with RDA
entries.references: TIE, Food and Nutrition for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Five: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of principles of Food and Nutrition
entries.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an understanding of the dietary needs for different groups of people
entries.learning_activity: (f) Plan meals for each group of individual with special dietary needs based on RDA, food composition table and Tanzania food based dietary guidelines
teaching_learning_activities: Gallery walk: Guide students to plan meals for groups with special dietary needs based on RDA, food composition table and Tanzania food based dietary guidelines
Discussion: Guide them to discuss what they have planned
entries.assessment: Meals for individuals with special dietary needs are well planned
entries.references: TIE, Food and Nutrition for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Five: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of principles of Food and Nutrition
entries.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an understanding of the dietary needs for different groups of people
entries.learning_activity: (g) Describe energy balance (meaning and components of energy expenditure)
teaching_learning_activities: Questions and answers: Provide questions for students to get the meaning of energy balance
Jigsaw: Organise students to discuss components of energy expenditure
Project activity: Task students in their club to calculate basal metabolic Index of different individuals
entries.assessment: Energy balance concept is well described
entries.references: TIE, Food and Nutrition for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Five: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of principles of Food and Nutrition
entries.specific_competence: 1.2 Conduct experiments on the nutrient present in different types of foods
entries.learning_activity: (a) Extract nutrients from selected foods (cereals, milk, coconut, seeds and nuts)
teaching_learning_activities: Skill lab: Demonstrate on how to extract nutrients from various foods
Organise students to perform the experiments to test the presence of nutrients in foods
entries.assessment: Various nutrients from selected foods are extracted
resources: Food items such as cereals, milk, coconut, seeds and nuts,
